name: Linear Slot Diffusers
description: A refined linear detail for contemporary ceilings and coordinated air distribution.
detail: Specify the slot arrangement, overall length, finish and plenum requirements for review with our factory team.

name: Ceiling Diffusers
description: A clean ceiling finish for distributing supply air into the room.
detail: Share the face size, neck size, air pattern and installation requirements so the correct configuration can be confirmed.

name: Sand Trap Louvers
description: An external intake solution for projects with sand separation requirements.
detail: Discuss face dimensions, frame depth, installation opening and project performance requirements before selection.

name: Linear Bar Grilles
description: Precise, continuous lines for supply and return air openings.
detail: Coordinate the bar profile, frame style, opening dimensions and mounting arrangement with your architectural detail.

name: Jet Diffusers
description: Directional air outlets with a distinctive circular profile.
detail: Provide the application, duct connection and airflow requirements for a project-specific selection discussion.

description: Duct-mounted components for regulating ventilation airflow.
detail: Confirm duct dimensions, blade arrangement and manual or actuator requirements with the factory. No fire or smoke rating is implied.

name: Disc Valves
description: Compact circular terminals for ventilation and exhaust openings.
detail: Share the connection diameter, intended use and ceiling interface for confirmation before ordering.

name: External Louvers

name: Round Ceiling Diffusers
description: A circular ceiling outlet for room air distribution.

name: Door Transfer Grilles
description: A grille solution for transferring air between adjacent spaces.
detail: Coordinate the door thickness, cut-out dimensions and appearance requirements before fabrication.

name: Egg-Crate Grilles
description: An open-grid face for return and exhaust air applications.
detail: Confirm the face dimensions, core and frame arrangement, and any access requirements for your installation.

name: Flowbar Slot Diffusers
description: A linear airflow solution for coordinated architectural ceiling details.
detail: Share the linear dimensions, ceiling junction detail and air distribution requirements for review.

name: Supply & Return Grilles

detail: Discuss blade arrangement, frame dimensions, opening size and damper requirements with our team.
